newsitem.title: USA: Shell cuts some crude, gas output due storm.
newsitem.headline: Shell cuts some crude, gas output due storm.

text.p: Shell Oil said Monday it reduced some crude and natural gas production at its Mars field in the U.S Gulf of Mexico as a precaution against Tropical Storm Josephine.
"There has been no overall evacuation, but we shut in Mars yesterday," a company spokeswoman said, adding about 25,000 barrels per day of crude and 25 million cubic feet per day of gas has been cut.
She was not sure when the cuts would be restored.

At 1400 EDT, Tropical Storm Josephine, with winds at 70 mph, was 110 miles south-southwest of Apalachicola, Florida, and moving northeast at 23 mph. Forecasters said it was likely to become a hurricane before making landfall sometime Monday night.
